//: Hand-written (14-sso/managed/reporting.tf): who has access to what in authentik, read from its database as the read-only role grafana_reader. Edit this file directly.
title: Who has access to what (authentik)

panels.title: Who can open what
panels.description: One row per user, one column per application. '?' = decided by an expression policy, check it in authentik.

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
people AS (
  SELECT id, username, name, email, type, is_active, last_login, date_joined
  FROM authentik_core_user
  WHERE type IN ('internal', 'external') AND username <> 'AnonymousUser'
),
membership(user_id, group_id) AS (
  SELECT user_id, group_id FROM authentik_core_user_groups
  UNION
  SELECT m.user_id, p.parent_id
  FROM membership m JOIN authentik_core_groupparentage p ON p.child_id = m.group_id
),
checks AS (
  SELECT u.id AS user_id, a.slug, a.name AS app, u.is_active, t.policy_engine_mode AS mode,
    CASE
      WHEN b.policy_binding_uuid IS NULL THEN true
      WHEN b.expiring AND b.expires < now() THEN false
      WHEN b.policy_id IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM membership m WHERE m.user_id = u.id AND m.group_id = b.group_id)
            OR COALESCE(b.user_id = u.id, false)) <> b.negate
    END AS passes
  FROM people u
  CROSS JOIN authentik_core_application a
  JOIN authentik_policies_policybindingmodel t ON t.pbm_uuid = a.policybindingmodel_ptr_id
  LEFT JOIN authentik_policies_policybinding b ON b.target_id = a.policybindingmodel_ptr_id AND b.enabled
),
access AS (
  SELECT user_id, slug, app,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT is_active THEN 'no'
      WHEN mode = 'all' AND bool_or(passes IS FALSE) THEN 'no'
      WHEN mode = 'all' AND bool_or(passes IS NULL) THEN '?'
      WHEN mode = 'all' THEN 'yes'
      WHEN bool_or(passes IS TRUE) THEN 'yes'
      WHEN bool_or(passes IS NULL) THEN '?'
      ELSE 'no'
    END AS access
  FROM checks
  GROUP BY user_id, slug, app, is_active, mode
)
SELECT u.username AS "user", a.app, a.access
FROM access a JOIN people u ON u.id = a.user_id
ORDER BY u.username, a.app

panels.title: People
panels.description: Every account: its groups, what it can open and how it signs in.

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
people AS (
  SELECT id, username, name, email, type, is_active, last_login, date_joined
  FROM authentik_core_user
  WHERE type IN ('internal', 'external') AND username <> 'AnonymousUser'
),
membership(user_id, group_id) AS (
  SELECT user_id, group_id FROM authentik_core_user_groups
  UNION
  SELECT m.user_id, p.parent_id
  FROM membership m JOIN authentik_core_groupparentage p ON p.child_id = m.group_id
),
checks AS (
  SELECT u.id AS user_id, a.slug, a.name AS app, u.is_active, t.policy_engine_mode AS mode,
    CASE
      WHEN b.policy_binding_uuid IS NULL THEN true
      WHEN b.expiring AND b.expires < now() THEN false
      WHEN b.policy_id IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM membership m WHERE m.user_id = u.id AND m.group_id = b.group_id)
            OR COALESCE(b.user_id = u.id, false)) <> b.negate
    END AS passes
  FROM people u
  CROSS JOIN authentik_core_application a
  JOIN authentik_policies_policybindingmodel t ON t.pbm_uuid = a.policybindingmodel_ptr_id
  LEFT JOIN authentik_policies_policybinding b ON b.target_id = a.policybindingmodel_ptr_id AND b.enabled
),
access AS (
  SELECT user_id, slug, app,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT is_active THEN 'no'
      WHEN mode = 'all' AND bool_or(passes IS FALSE) THEN 'no'
      WHEN mode = 'all' AND bool_or(passes IS NULL) THEN '?'
      WHEN mode = 'all' THEN 'yes'
      WHEN bool_or(passes IS TRUE) THEN 'yes'
      WHEN bool_or(passes IS NULL) THEN '?'
      ELSE 'no'
    END AS access
  FROM checks
  GROUP BY user_id, slug, app, is_active, mode
)
SELECT u.username AS "User", u.name AS "Name", u.email AS "E-mail",
  CASE WHEN u.is_active THEN 'active' ELSE 'disabled' END AS "Status",
  (SELECT string_agg(g.name, ', ' ORDER BY g.name)
     FROM authentik_core_user_groups ug JOIN authentik_core_group g ON g.group_uuid = ug.group_id
    WHERE ug.user_id = u.id) AS "Groups",
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM membership m JOIN authentik_core_group g ON g.group_uuid = m.group_id
                    WHERE m.user_id = u.id AND g.is_superuser) THEN 'yes' ELSE '' END AS "authentik admin",
  (SELECT string_agg(a.app, ', ' ORDER BY a.app) FROM access a WHERE a.user_id = u.id AND a.access = 'yes') AS "Can open",
  concat_ws(', ',
    (SELECT string_agg(s.name, ', ' ORDER BY s.name)
       FROM authentik_core_usersourceconnection c
       JOIN authentik_core_source s ON s.policybindingmodel_ptr_id = c.source_id
      WHERE c.user_id = u.id),
    (SELECT 'passkey x' || count(*) FROM authentik_stages_authenticator_webauthn_webauthndevice d
      WHERE d.user_id = u.id HAVING count(*) > 0)) AS "Signs in with",
  u.last_login AS "Last login", u.date_joined AS "Created"
FROM people u
ORDER BY u.username

panels.title: Groups
panels.description: Members of each group and the applications that name the group (or a parent of it).

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE lineage(group_id, ancestor_id) AS (
  SELECT group_uuid, group_uuid FROM authentik_core_group
  UNION
  SELECT l.group_id, p.parent_id
  FROM lineage l JOIN authentik_core_groupparentage p ON p.child_id = l.ancestor_id
)
SELECT g.name AS "Group", CASE WHEN g.is_superuser THEN 'yes' ELSE '' END AS "authentik admin",
  (SELECT string_agg(u.username, ', ' ORDER BY u.username)
     FROM authentik_core_user_groups ug JOIN authentik_core_user u ON u.id = ug.user_id
    WHERE ug.group_id = g.group_uuid) AS "Direct members",
  (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT a.name, ', ' ORDER BY a.name)
     FROM lineage l
     JOIN authentik_policies_policybinding b ON b.group_id = l.ancestor_id AND b.enabled AND NOT b.negate
     JOIN authentik_core_application a ON a.policybindingmodel_ptr_id = b.target_id
    WHERE l.group_id = g.group_uuid) AS "Bound to applications"
FROM authentik_core_group g
ORDER BY g.name

panels.title: Pending invitations
panels.description: Links not yet used or expired. The link itself is only visible in authentik.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT i.name AS "Invitation", COALESCE(f.slug, '(any invitation flow)') AS "Flow",
  CASE WHEN i.single_use THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS "Single use",
  CASE WHEN i.expiring THEN i.expires END AS "Expires"
FROM authentik_stages_invitation_invitation i
LEFT JOIN authentik_flows_flow f ON f.flow_uuid = i.flow_id
WHERE NOT i.expiring OR i.expires > now()
ORDER BY i.name
